```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
profile <- params$profile
calibration <- read_validation_table("validation_calibration_summary", profile)
```

# Global-null Binary Scenarios

```{r}
global_null <- calibration |>
  filter(scenario_family == "global_binary", is_true_null) |>
  arrange(n, within_r, group, direction)
kable_if_rows(compact_columns(global_null, c(
  "n", "within_r", "between_r", "group", "direction",
  "attempted", "fit_failure_rate", "retention_rate",
  "rejection_rate_unconditional", "rejection_unconditional_lcl",
  "rejection_unconditional_ucl", "rejection_rate_retained",
  "null_coverage"
)), "Global-null Type I error")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
plot_data <- global_null |>
  mutate(setting = paste0("n=", n, ", r=", within_r))
safe_rate_plot(plot_data, "setting", "rejection_rate_unconditional",
               title = "Unconditional rejection rate under the global null")
```

# Boundary and All-zero Diagnostics

```{r}
diag_tab <- global_null |>
  select(n, within_r, group, direction, lambda_boundary_rate, all_zero_rate,
         median_boot_success_rate, median_runtime_sec)
kable_if_rows(diag_tab, "Global-null backend diagnostics")
```
